summary: A Depth subscription across a dropped socket: the book and price merged before the drop do not survive it; the next connection's first book comes without the old price.

notes: Audit RB-06 (prior-session state): the web clears its merged fields when a connection ends; the desktop clears them in on_connected (1.0.6).
The session token is sent percent-decoded in x-session-token (samcoWebSocket.py: unquote).

deviations.reason: Before Samco's first quote the web sends change and change_percentage as 0.0, values the book stream never carried (samcoWebSocket._normalize_market_data defaults ch and chPer to 0); the desktop leaves them out.
deviations.ref: samcoWebSocket.py _normalize_market_data; decisions 2026-11-09 (web zeros for values the stream did not send)

deviations.reason: The web sends Depth clients nothing on a quote packet (samco_adapter.py _on_data routes quote frames to LTP and Quote subscriptions only), so a Depth-only client's price, volume and OI stand still until Samco's next book; the desktop refreshes Depth from the cached book on every quote packet, under its one frame per held mode policy (audit C08).
deviations.ref: samco_adapter.py _on_data (target_modes [3] for quote2, [1, 2] for quote); audit C08; lead ruling 2026-11-09

deviations.reason: Before Samco's first quote the web sends the quote fields as 0 (volume, open, high, low, close, last_quantity), values the book stream never carried; the desktop leaves them out and keeps ltp and timestamp (1.0.6 decision).
